newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone HK flotation oversubscribed - sources.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone HK flotation oversubscribed - sources.

text.p: Public offering of shares of mobile telephone operator SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Ltd in Hong Kong was several times oversubscribed and the international placement portion was also oversubscribed, market sources close to the deal said on Friday.
Sources said the price was fixed at HK$17.25 per share for the 84 million shares.
Sources said "56 percent of the deal was placed in Asia, 34 percent in Europe and 10 percent in the U.S.," the sources said.

SmarTone offered 84 million shares globally in which 15 percent of the issue, or 12.6 million shares, were offered in Hong Kong and 85 percent was for international placement. The public offer closed on Friday.
An official announcement on the subscription results is due to release on October 30.
Dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on October 31.

SmarTone is 40 percent owned by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, 30 percent by AT&T Wireless Communications, 15 percent by ABC Communications (Holdings) Ltd, and 15 percent by Town Khan Ltd, a unit of China's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications.
